# Luckys Promo

> Luckys Promo is a corporate gifting and promotional merchandise company based in Bengaluru, India, operated as a venture of Manpointe Tech LLP. We supply customized corporate gift sets, executive diaries, drinkware, pens, keychains, bags, and tech accessories, with in-house logo printing (screen, digital, offset foil stamping, and UV printing) for bulk and enterprise orders across India.

Key facts:
- ISO 9001:2015 certified corporate supply partner
- Minimum order quantities typically start at 50 units, with tiered bulk pricing
- Pan-India doorstep delivery, with global shipping support
- Contact: info@luckyspromo.com, +91 78920 81305, WhatsApp available
- Address: Amrutahalli, Byatarayanapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560092
